column1: # Package|Description|comma-separated paths or selectors owned by this package
# These paths are intentionally distinct from top-level SONAME packages.  They
# cover data and dlopen modules needed by a GTK/Wayland desktop after the
# eventual base-image thinning.  @remaining-* is a reviewable catch-all for
# paths whose package-specific owner has not been split yet; it still gives
# every file a single explicit feed owner instead of silently borrowing it.
gtk3-data|GTK3 themes, input modules, and print backends|/usr/share/gtk-3.0,/usr/lib/gtk-3.0
gdk-pixbuf-loaders|GDK Pixbuf image loader modules and metadata|/usr/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0
glib-networking|GIO TLS backend modules|/usr/lib/gio/modules
tdvp-gdk-committed-compat|TDVP wf-panel-pi GTK committed-signal compatibility runtime|/usr/lib/tdvp-gdk-committed-compat.so
tdvp-hardware-runtime|TDVP hardware state service and Vivante dynamic runtime|/usr/libexec/vicliu-pocket-linux-hardware/vpl-hardwared,/usr/lib/libvg_lite.so
pulse-modules|PulseAudio runtime modules and default configuration|/usr/lib/pulseaudio,/etc/pulse
alsa-data|ALSA UCM and profile data|/usr/share/alsa
mesa-dri-drivers|Mesa DRI software renderer modules|/usr/lib/dri,/usr/share/drirc.d
openssl-modules|OpenSSL provider modules|/usr/lib/ossl-modules
ca-certificates|TLS trust store|/etc/ssl
adwaita-icon-theme|Adwaita icon resources|/usr/share/icons/Adwaita
hicolor-icon-theme|Hicolor icon resources|/usr/share/icons/hicolor
shared-mime-info|Shared MIME database|/usr/share/mime
tdvp-runtime-modules|Remaining non-ABI runtime modules below usr/lib|@remaining-usr-lib
tdvp-runtime-libexec|Remaining non-ABI runtime modules and helpers below usr/libexec|@remaining-usr-libexec
tdvp-runtime-data|Remaining non-ABI userland data below usr/share|@remaining-usr-share
